images.caption: Front of the Cooke-Robertson House, located at 412 Columbus Avenue in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1835, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Cooke-Robertson House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Cooke-Robertson House (Sandusky, 1880): a limestone Italianate double house on a high basement, a bracketed cornice, paired doors up a double iron-railed stoop under a small roof, basement flats below; row houses on each side

why.note: Sandusky's own limestone: the 'Stone City' of Lake Erie, quarried under the town
a stone double house: two families on a downtown lot
